title: Sleep planner & WHOOP models
description: WHOOP's sleep planner (when to go to bed) and its scores (sleep need and debt, performance, consistency, recovery, strain), rebuilt from a WHOOP strap's, a Fitbit's or a Garmin's own data by the WHOOP models connector.

links.title: Refresh now
links.tooltip: Fetch the latest data, then rerun the WHOOP models (Tributary)

list.label: Wake-up at

list.name: bed
list.label: In bed at
list.description: A bedtime to try: the share of the need it gives (seconds after the midnight before the night: 00:30 is 88200).

options.content:
**WHOOP's sleep planner and scores, rebuilt from any device.** The *WHOOP models* connector reads each
device's nights and heart rate (a WHOOP strap through the Whoop connector, a Fitbit through fitbit-grafana, a Garmin
through garmin-grafana) and recomputes what the WHOOP app shows: the **sleep need** (a baseline, plus what the day's
strain adds, plus half of last night's shortfall), the **sleep performance**, the **consistency**, the **recovery**
(the night's HRV against its own 30-night mean) and the **day strain** (from the heart rate, for a device that has no
strain of its own). One line per device; a dashed grey line is the app's own value, where a strap writes it.
How the models were found and how close they come: docs/connectors/whoop_model.md.

panels.title: Tonight: when to go to bed for ${goal:text}, up at ${wake:text}
$input · in bed by
panels.description: When to be in bed for the goal and the wake-up picked above, if the day ends at the strain so far: wake-up − goal × sleep need ÷ the 14-night median efficiency − time to fall asleep. The need is the baseline, what today's strain adds and the debt carried from last night.

targets.query: SELECT (last("wake_day_s") + $wake - $goal * last("need_s_so_far") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) * 1000 AS "in bed by" FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" = '$input' AND time > now() - 7d

panels.title: $input · if the day ends at strain
panels.description: Today's strain adds to tonight's need and is not known before the day ends: the same bedtime if it ends at strain 8, 12 or 16.

targets.query: SELECT (last("wake_day_s") + $wake - $goal * last("need_s_strain8") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) * 1000 AS "strain 8", (last("wake_day_s") + $wake - $goal * last("need_s_strain12") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) * 1000 AS "strain 12", (last("wake_day_s") + $wake - $goal * last("need_s_strain16") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) * 1000 AS "strain 16" FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" = '$input' AND time > now() - 7d

panels.title: If I go to bed at ${bed:text}
$input · share of the need slept
panels.description: The other way round: in bed at the time picked above, up at the wake-up, how much of tonight's need you would sleep: (in bed − time to fall asleep) × efficiency ÷ need, at the strain so far and at 8, 12, 16. Orange below 70 % (Get by) and 85 % (Perform), green from 85 %, bright green from 100 % (Peak).

targets.query: SELECT ($wake + 86400 - $bed - last("latency_s")) * last("efficiency") / last("need_s_so_far") AS "strain so far", ($wake + 86400 - $bed - last("latency_s")) * last("efficiency") / last("need_s_strain8") AS "strain 8", ($wake + 86400 - $bed - last("latency_s")) * last("efficiency") / last("need_s_strain12") AS "strain 12", ($wake + 86400 - $bed - last("latency_s")) * last("efficiency") / last("need_s_strain16") AS "strain 16" FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" = '$input' AND time > now() - 7d

panels.title: $input · in bed at ${bed:text}
panels.description: The sleep you would get in bed from the time picked to the wake-up, against tonight's need at the strain so far.

targets.query: SELECT ($wake + 86400 - $bed - last("latency_s")) * last("efficiency") / 100 / 3600 AS "asleep", last("need_s_so_far") / 3600 AS "need" FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" = '$input' AND time > now() - 7d

options.content:
**[↻ Refresh now](${tributary}/connectors/whoop_model/refresh)**: fetch the latest data (the tools with a refresh hook are asked to
fetch, the Whoop connector runs), then rerun the WHOOP models. Open the device's phone app first, so it has synced.
The link needs the dashboard's `tributary` variable: the address of Tributary.

panels.title: Is the data fresh?
panels.description: What the bedtimes above stand on, per device: when the WHOOP models connector last ran (*Refresh now*, above, after a late workout or a sync), the last night it read, its sleep against the usual (the median of the 14 nights before), and when the device's heart rate was last seen. *Still syncing*: the heart rate stops before the night's end. *Looks cut short*: under 60 % of the usual sleep, or ending 3 h or more before the usual wake-up: the source had not finished the night (a Fitbit night is finished by Google Health hours after the wake-up). Either way the debt is too high and the bedtime too early, until the source rewrites the night and the connector runs again.

targets.query: SELECT last("run_s") * 1000 AS "model ran", last("night_start_s") * 1000 AS "fell asleep", last("night_end_s") * 1000 AS "woke up", last("night_asleep_s") / 3600 AS "slept", last("usual_asleep_s") / 3600 AS "usually", last("partial") + 2 * last("cut_short") AS "last night", last("synced_s") * 1000 AS "device last synced" FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Sleep need tonight
panels.description: Baseline + what the strain so far adds + the debt carried from last night.

targets.query: SELECT last("need_s_so_far") / 3600 FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Debt carried from last night
panels.description: Half of last night's shortfall (need − sleep); 9/14 after a night scored above 87.

targets.query: SELECT last("debt_s") / 60 FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Strain so far
panels.description: Today's cycle, from last night's sleep onset: WHOOP's own for a strap, from the heart rate otherwise.

targets.query: SELECT last("strain_so_far") FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Sleep need at strain 12
panels.description: Baseline + what a day at strain 12 adds + the debt.

targets.query: SELECT last("need_s_strain12") / 3600 FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Efficiency
panels.description: Time asleep ÷ time in bed, the median of the last 14 nights.

targets.query: SELECT last("efficiency") FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Time to fall asleep
panels.description: The median of the last 14 nights.

targets.query: SELECT last("latency_s") / 60 FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: WHOOP's scores, rebuilt from each device
Recovery
panels.description: The app's recovery and the model's: 100·σ(h·(ln HRV − its 30-night mean) + p·performance + c).

targets.query: SELECT mean("recovery_score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("recovery") FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Day strain
panels.description: The cycle that starts with the night (sleep onset to the next one): WHOOP's own for a strap; from the heart rate otherwise, a·ln(1 + Banister's TRIMP / b).

targets.query: SELECT mean("strain") FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("day_strain") FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep need
panels.description: Baseline + strain + debt − naps: the app's own sum, and the model's.

targets.query: SELECT (mean("need_baseline_s") + mean("need_strain_s") + mean("need_debt_s") - mean("need_nap_s")) / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("need_s") / 3600 FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep debt carried into the night
panels.description: The share of the nights before still owed.

targets.query: SELECT mean("need_debt_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("need_debt_s") / 60 FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep performance
panels.description: The app's sleep performance, and the model's: sleep against need, efficiency and consistency.

targets.query: SELECT mean("score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("sleep_score") FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep consistency
panels.description: How much the night's sleep window overlaps the four before it.

targets.query: SELECT mean("consistency_pct") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("consistency") FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')
